precedence: Load with profile.json as ONE effective route-control.v0.2.1 policy; below explicit invariants refine profile. No v0.1 or legacy free-host policy in the same episode.

F1_unresolved_scope.rule: delegated_unresolved is a handoff record, not a committed method role. Keep affected scope/owner=original_host/reason/relevant observations in unresolved; no active primary/support/constraint method assignment for that unresolved scope. Successful independent scope commitments remain active. Do not count its later host work as Jev-routed execution.
F1_unresolved_scope.no_erasure: Pending method obligations/observations survive in unresolved, not erased or marked passed.

F2_consistency.parent_partial: At least one committed/direct and at least one pending scope; not an extra per-issue mode.
F2_consistency.committed: Exactly one established primary for each conclusion scope; supports/constraints bind same scope. For host-direct work with only method support, require explicit established original_host primary responsibility rather than inventing a method owner.
F2_consistency.different_issues: Separate primaries allowed, no global single-winner constraint.
F2_consistency.invalid_record: Do not publish invalid scope as committed; retain its observations in unresolved, preserve valid independent scopes.

F3_mode_boundary.episode_policy: one public profile and one journal/budget per episode; reuse lower-level existing relationship check/correct components with same episode context, never nest a second public entry.run/root/profile or simply remove existing route=False protection
F3_mode_boundary.regression: Test double-mode/double-budget rejection and unchanged legacy profiles.

when: S02 native distribution absent or invalid
F4_attention_unknown.raw_observation: retain separately including any numeric value; never substitute zero
F4_attention_unknown.effect: No numeric ordering/depth weighting from this result; use original user priorities/method obligations. Other valid route roles remain usable.
F4_attention_unknown.assessability: actual S01 positive OR source-bound valid existing_resolution, not mandatory repeated S01
